description:
Add your server details including the IP address, SSH user credentials, and Traefik configuration.
This server will be used to host and manage your self-hosted Frappe applications, both public and private.

Once added, you can prepare the server (install Docker and Docker Compose), deploy Traefik for routing and SSL management, and then use this server to deploy benches and sites directly from your Frappe app
name: Create a Server
title: Create a Server
